name: Nether Earth GS: construction
summary: The construction menu, robot placement on the map, the menus' sound call.

entries.name: ConstructionMenu
entries.summary: landing on the warbase pad at altitude 15: choose the parts (MenuCursor, MenuParts), START ROBOT or EXIT MENU

entries.name: ConstructionMenuSetup
entries.summary: reset the preview robot, copy the resources, cursor on BIPOD, nothing chosen

entries.name: ConstructionMenuLoop
entries.summary: wait for a control; fire acts on the cursor's item, a direction moves the cursor

entries.name: RefundPart
entries.summary: give back the cost of part E to MenuResources, the overflow to the general resource

entries.name: MoveMenuCursor
entries.summary: right / left change the column (0-2), down / up the part row (0-7) in column 2

entries.name: StartRobot
entries.summary: START ROBOT: needs a chassis and a weapon; spend the resources, place the robot at the warbase's door, leave

entries.name: PaintMenuCursor
entries.summary: paint the item under MenuCursor with attribute C ($46 the cursor, $45 the rest)

entries.name: FillAttributes
entries.summary: write C into B bytes from HL

entries.name: PrintMenuResources
entries.summary: print MenuResources (two digits each) and their total

entries.name: PrintMenuTotal
entries.summary: Construction menu: print the total of the costs (the tail of $CBE0)

entries.name: PrintMenuResource
entries.summary: Construction menu: print one resource value A at row C, column 13

entries.name: PrintMenuResourceValue
entries.summary: Construction menu: print A as two digits, registers kept (the tail of $CC08)

entries.name: ShowRobotDesign
entries.summary: Construction menu: highlight the chosen parts and draw the robot preview

entries.name: PlaceRobot
entries.summary: Put robot IY at map column HL, row B: record, map bit 6, radar dot

entries.name: ShipCell
entries.summary: HL = the map cell under the ship (ShipX, ShipY)

entries.name: MapCell
entries.summary: HL = the map cell of column HL, row A: $DD00 + $200*A + HL

entries.name: Beep
entries.summary: A menu sound: GS id A (the old beeper tone's half-period)

labels.comment: the GS menu sound; it sets IY = Robots, the player's slots 0-23

all 24 slots in use: no menu at all

cut to 24 lines, the part's 3 character rows

labels.name: ConstructionTitleText
labels.comment: PrintInline text: "ROBOT" (double size) at row 0, "CONSTRUCTION" (double height) at row 2

labels.comment: PrintInline text: the part names at column 21, ELECTRONICS row 1 down to BIPOD row 22, every 3 rows
the part names in $45 (cyan), column 21: ELECTRONICS, row 1

labels.name: ExitStartText
labels.comment: PrintInline text: "EXIT START" / "MENU ROBOT" at rows 21-22, columns 5 and 10
the buttons EXIT MENU (column 5) and START ROBOT (column 10), rows 21-22

labels.name: PartCostsText
labels.comment: PrintInline text: the costs under the names at column 22: 3 20 4 4 2 10 5 3 (the same numbers as PartCosts)
the costs in $43 (magenta), column 22: electronics 3, row 2
